Skill-Lebenszyklus, Aktivierung pro Work: Skill lifecycle, activation per workflow, execution in the skill-capability block
Skills sind ein optionales Modul (`skill: Skills are an optional module (`skills`, in the preset `full`). Every change goes through `SkillMutationGateway`, which writes a version row.
Capabilities entstehen nicht beim Anlege: Capabilities are not created along with a skill: they come from the built-in skills (`skills/builtin/*.json`, loaded at startup) or from an import (`POST /api/v1/skills/import`). Built-ins are read-only; the gateway refuses changes to a skill that a sealed workflow uses with 409.
Vor dem ersten Block schreibt der Run de: Before the first block, the run writes the `aiContext` of the activated skills to `.claude/rules/skills-context.md` in the project (`CommandExecutorService.writeSkillContextToProject`); a block with its own `skillIds` adds them for its duration. The Claude CLI reads `.claude/rules/` by itself, Codex and Pi get the file appended to the system prompt.
